one_liner: Josh Hart grabs 9 rebounds per 36 minutes -- a big-man rebounding rate from a perimeter player who scores 12.4 per 36.
three_things: 9 rebounds per 36 alongside 5.2 assists: the line of a connector, not a scorer.
Scoring is secondary at 12.4 per 36, but efficient at 49.1 percent from the field.
He was available for 223 games in the window.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used. Rebound rate carries no position, lineup, or scheme adjustment -- a wing on a team that leaks defensive boards rates higher for reasons that are not his.
